exception_title: K-1 vs K-3 Base Form Conflict
exception_description: Single base I-129F used for both K-1 and K-3; separate fee and evidence requirements not enforced at intake.
Petitioner claims in-person meeting within 2 years but date entered predates relationship start date on Part 3.
Beneficiary turns 21 before visa issuance; automatic K-2 child aging-out not flagged when DOB parsed in DD/MM vs MM/DD.
Petitioner has prior marriage; divorce decree not attached; system marks petition complete despite missing supporting doc.
Beneficiary is in US on tourist visa; K-1 filed from abroad while alien is present; creates dual intent conflict.
Civil document dates in DD-MM-YYYY format OCR'd as MM-DD-YYYY; inverts birth month and day fields.
Case forwarded to NVC before I-129F approval notice generated; creates orphan NVC record.
LLM scores bona fide relationship narrative as low-confidence without flagging specific factual gaps to officer.
Two USC petitioners file K-1 for same beneficiary; second filing not blocked pending disposition of first.
DOS schedules interview before USCIS I-129F approval; state machine allows forward jump.
K-1 visa issued; 90-day entry window and subsequent 2-year marriage requirement tracked in different fiscal year buckets.
Beneficiary's romanized name has variant spellings; only primary spelling checked against watch-list.
LLM misclassifies WhatsApp conversation evidence as platonic; reduces relationship-strength score incorrectly.
Two law firms share one employer portal; K-1 evidence packet of firm A visible to firm B users.

exception_title: K-2 Child Record Orphaned on Denial
exception_description: Parent K-1 denied; K-2 derivative child record remains in active queue without cascade-delete or status update.
